name: Build from scratch
summary: The highest-control, highest-cost option. A basic editor is not the problem; X6-parity interaction, history, clipboard, stencil, routing, snapping, export, accessibility and browser testing are. Not recommended for an application.

spike.scenario: Not spiked: build option, no implementation without a product decision.
spike.notes: Use D3/Cytoscape/Sigma as rendering inputs only if you accept a custom editor build. For an application, this is a last resort.
